thanks.heading: Thank you
thanks.body: Your tip went straight to the artist's own Stripe account. It will appear on your statement under their name.
thanks.saveBody: Sign in or create an account and we'll save this tip to it, so you can see every tip you've left in one place. Entirely optional.
thanks.saveCta: Save this tip to my account →
thanks.receipt: Your receipt comes by email from the artist's Stripe account, under their business name, to the address you gave at checkout.
thanks.refundBody: The artist is the seller, so refunds come from them; their contact details are on your receipt. If you can't reach them, email support@unstream.stream and we'll pass it on.

panel.goesLive: (goes live once Unstream has checked your setup)
panel.payoutsInStripe: Payouts, refunds and receipts in Stripe ↗
panel.stripeConnected: Stripe is connected. We check each artist's first setup by hand, so it's clear the account belongs to you — usually within a day. You can get everything ready meanwhile.
